component.name: IngeTrazo
component.summary: Free 3D modeler for architecture, engineering and BIM
Modelador 3D libre para arquitectura, ingeniería y BIM

description.p: This is a community package of IngeTrazo, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the IngeTrazo project. It repackages the official upstream Linux tarball unmodified — unpacked at install time, not rebuilt — and follows upstream releases automatically.

IngeTrazo is a free 3D modeler for drawing as if by hand: push/pull modelling, groups and components, materials, dimensions, layers, scenes and a sheet composer that turns the model into to-scale plan sheets.

ul.li: Opens .skp files natively (2013–2026) and reads and writes .igz documents.
Imports and exports COLLADA, OBJ, STL and glTF/GLB.
Tags geometry with IFC classes and exports IFC4 for quantity take-off.
Brings in base-map tiles, 3D terrain and survey points.
Sheet composer with vector PDF and DXF export.

description.p: Permissions: this package grants read-write access to Documents, Downloads and Pictures, because a model keeps textures and linked files by path and they have to stay reachable when the file is reopened. GPU access is required for the viewport. Network access is used for base-map tiles, elevation data and geocoding. Settings stay inside the sandbox.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Projects anywhere under your home folder: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.ingetrazo.IngeTrazo
Files on a removable drive: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/media com.ingetrazo.IngeTrazo
A 3D mouse served by spacenavd: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/run/spnav.sock:ro com.ingetrazo.IngeTrazo
Printing through the system CUPS service: flatpak override --user --socket=cups com.ingetrazo.IngeTrazo

Starting a Blender installed on the host, for Render with Blender: flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.Flatpak --filesystem=~/.cache/IngeTrazo:create com.ingetrazo.IngeTrazo (the render job is written to ~/.cache/IngeTrazo, where the host Blender can read it)
